name: Nocturne
overview: Ex-soldier Jonah Lynn leaves Philadelphia for a quiet life. When serial killer Jurek Walter threatens his new home and family, Jonah must protect them — even as he sends his FBI agent daughter Saga to track the killer's last victim.
creator: NOFLIX Series

name: Dexter: Resurrection
overview: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. But when Miami Metro's Angel Batista arrives with questions, Dexter realises his past is catching up with him fast.
creator: Clyde Phillips

name: Friends
overview: Six twenty-somethings share coffee, apartments, terrible dates and every awkward milestone of adult life in Manhattan. Three decades on, it is still the comfort watch the whole world agrees on.
creator: David Crane & Marta Kauffman

name: Attack on Titan
overview: Humanity lives caged inside enormous walls, hiding from the man-eating Titans outside. When the walls are breached, Eren Yeager swears revenge — and discovers the truth about what he really is.
creator: Wit Studio / MAPPA

name: Demon Slayer
overview: Tanjiro Kamado comes home to find his family slaughtered and his sister turned into a demon. He joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure — and the animation will ruin every other fight scene for you.
creator: ufotable

name: The Walking Dead
overview: Sheriff Rick Grimes wakes from a coma into a world overrun by the dead, and rebuilds a group of survivors one loss at a time. The dead are dangerous — the living are worse.
creator: Frank Darabont

name: Sherlock
overview: A modern-day Sherlock Holmes solves impossible crimes from a flat on Baker Street, with Dr John Watson documenting every deduction. Witty, immaculate and almost unbearably tense.
creator: Steven Moffat & Mark Gatiss

name: Better Call Saul
overview: Jimmy McGill is a struggling lawyer with a gift for the grift. The slow, gorgeous transformation of a decent man into Saul Goodman is one of the best-written tragedies television has produced.
creator: Vince Gilligan & Peter Gould

name: 3 Idiots
overview: Two friends set out to find the brilliant, infuriating Rancho, the college roommate who taught them that chasing excellence beats chasing success. A Bollywood landmark about the price of an engineering degree.
creator: Rajkumar Hirani

name: The Dog Stars
overview: In a post-apocalyptic world a virus has wiped out humanity. Survivor and pilot Hig lost his wife but kept his Cessna — and when a faint signal crackles through the static, he flies toward it.
creator: Ridley Scott

name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
overview: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man, until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change in his powers and a powerful new enemy emerges from the wreckage of his old life.
creator: Destin Daniel Cretton

name: Hope
overview: A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of a remote harbour town, and its residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before.
creator: Na Hong-jin

name: Resident Evil
overview: A hapless courier is tasked with delivering a package to a remote hospital and finds himself in the middle of an outbreak, fighting through hordes of mutated creatures just to survive the night.
creator: Zach Cregger

name: Backrooms
overview: An angry architect chases the source of impossible power failures until a glowing gap opens in his basement. Beyond it lies a yellow maze that threatens his sanity, his friends and everything he loves.
creator: Kane Parsons

name: Obsession
overview: After breaking the mysterious One Wish Willow to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic gets exactly what he asked for — and discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.
creator: Curry Barker

name: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh is hired to ghostwrite the final novels of an injured bestselling author. Living in the Crawfords' home, she uncovers disturbing truths about the woman whose voice she is pretending to be.
creator: Michael Showalter

name: Forgotten Island
overview: Two best friends are stranded on the mystical world of Nakali, where their only way home might cost them the shared lifetime of memories that made them friends in the first place.
creator: Joel Crawford & Januel P. Mercado

name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
overview: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town and tries to bring it home. His charming, catastrophic misunderstanding of the holiday is stop-motion perfection.
creator: Henry Selick

name: Coraline
overview: Wandering her family's creaking new house, a bored young girl finds a hidden door to a strangely idealised version of her life with attentive button-eyed parents. It seems too good to be true — because it is.
creator: Henry Selick

name: Halloween
overview: Fifteen years after murdering his sister on Halloween night 1963, Michael Myers escapes from a mental hospital and returns to Haddonfield, Illinois, to kill again. The template every slasher still copies.
creator: John Carpenter

name: Hocus Pocus
overview: A teenage boy and his little sister move to Salem, where he accidentally awakens a trio of diabolical witches executed in the 17th century. Campy, chaotic Halloween comfort food.
creator: Kenny Ortega
